withdrawStake().details: CEI ordering (zero before send) prevents reentrancy without the nonReentrant modifier.

emergencyResolve(uint16).notice: Emergency resolve: force-settle from any non-terminal state. Callable only by the factory. Uses dispute resolution math for proportional split.

expireMilestoneNoQuorum(uint8,string).notice: Advances an expired milestone review cycle into dispute when quorum did not finalize in time.

expireNoQuorum(string).notice: Advances an expired single-shot review cycle into dispute when quorum did not finalize in time.

fundWithAuthorization(address,uint256,ui.notice: Fund via EIP-3009 signed authorization (gasless). Any caller may submit; `from` must be the buyer.

withdrawStake().notice: Withdraw verifier stake owed to the caller after quorum settlement or refund.
